name: Kashmiri Papier-Mache
description: Intricately hand-painted decorative objects made from paper pulp, a Persian-origin craft flourishing in Kashmir since the 14th century.

name: Channapatna Toys
description: Colorful lacquered wooden toys and dolls, a craft tradition dating back to Tipu Sultan's era.

name: Kondapalli Toys
description: Lightweight wooden toys carved from local Tella Poniki wood, depicting rural life and mythology.

name: Bankura Terracotta
description: Iconic elongated-neck terracotta horses and folk art, hand-shaped by traditional Kumbhakar potter communities.

name: Blue Pottery
description: Persian-influenced glazed pottery made without clay, using quartz powder, distinctive for its cobalt blue dye.

name: Aranmula Kannadi
description: Handcrafted metal mirrors made from a secret bronze alloy, produced by only a few families in Aranmula village.

name: Nagaland Bamboo Craft
description: Traditional bamboo and cane products including baskets, mats, and furniture, integral to Naga tribal daily life and festivals.

name: Walnut Wood Carving
description: Ornately carved furniture and decor made from Kashmir walnut wood, renowned for its fine grain and durability.

name: Firozabad Glassware
description: Hand-blown coloured glass bangles and decorative items, earning Firozabad the title 'Glass City of India'.

name: Meerut Scissors
description: Traditional hand-forged scissors and cutting tools, a centuries-old metalworking craft of Meerut.

name: Molela Clay Work
description: Terracotta plaques depicting deities and folk gods, handmade by the Kumhar potter community of Molela village.

name: Meenakari Jewelry
description: Vivid enamel work on gold and silver jewelry, a Mughal-era craft perfected by Jaipur's artisans.

name: Pipli Applique Work
description: Colourful applique craft using cutout fabric patches, traditionally used for temple umbrellas and canopies.

name: Konark Stone Carving
description: Intricate stone sculpture tradition famous for the carvings of the Konark Sun Temple.

name: Cuttack Silver Filigree
description: Delicate silver wire jewelry and decor, hand-twisted into intricate lace-like patterns by Cuttack's silversmiths.

name: Purulia Chau Mask
description: Vividly painted papier-mache masks worn during the traditional Chau dance-drama of Purulia.

name: Santiniketan Leather Goods
description: Hand-tooled and batik-dyed leather bags and accessories originating from the Santiniketan region founded by Tagore.

name: Mahabalipuram Stone Sculpture
description: Granite stone sculpture tradition dating to the Pallava dynasty, famous for the rock-cut monuments of Mahabalipuram.

name: Thanjavur Bommai
description: Traditional bobble-head dolls hand-painted in vivid colours, a folk craft distinct from Thanjavur paintings.

name: Kolhapuri Chappal
description: Handcrafted leather sandals made using vegetable-tanned leather, worn for centuries and famous worldwide.

name: Sikki Grass Craft
description: Fine golden grass woven into decorative boxes, toys and idols, a traditional Mithila handicraft.

name: Bastar Wood Carving
description: Intricately carved wooden sculptures and masks made by tribal artisans of Bastar, depicting deities and folklore.
